title: Ecoclock Network — GUI Client
desc: Ecoclock Network — GUI client to contribute distributed computing to environmental monitoring projects.
sub: Donate your machine's idle computing power to verified satellite imagery and biodiversity analysis projects. No miners. No blockchain. No hype.
meta1: macOS not supported in beta · iOS: planned (requires an Apple certificate) ·
how_s: Three steps. Nothing to install from the console.
s1p: Email and password. One user per machine. No card, no tracking.
s2p: The GUI or the APK receives a task from the server (NDVI, Posidonia, biodiversity) based on Copernicus data. You decide whether to run it.
s3p: Every solved task grants Eco'clock credit. No monetary value, but with symbolic value.
sci_s: They are not random tasks. The server prepares jobs from open Copernicus (ESA) data, mostly satellite imagery and derived products. Your machine computes a verifiable result; you earn symbolic Eco'clock credits.
ndvi: NDVI / vegetation — index derived from red and near-infrared bands (or CLMS tree cover density products). Used to track the health of forests, crops and land cover changes.
pos: Posidonia — seagrass meadows in the Mediterranean (e.g. around the Balearic Islands). The task estimates area or presence from coastal scenes.
bio: Biodiversity — auxiliary indicators (e.g. presence or scores) over geographic units defined in the task payload.
note: Sample view centered on Mallorca (Balearic Islands). If the CDSE catalogue does not respond, the server may generate filler tasks of the same type; the client always computes a verifiable output (NDVI, area, metrics, etc.).
rank_s: The 5 teams with the most members in the network. Join one or create your own from the app or the GUI.
rank_foot: Updated when the page loads · Name, logo and member count only

beta_p: We are looking for 5–50 beta testers to install the client, try it for 10 minutes and give us feedback. We care especially about how it fails, not how it works.
f_text: GUI client to contribute distributed computing to environmental projects.
